title: Model Information Delivery Plan (MIDP)

scope.purpose: Define the governed master schedule of information deliverables, milestones, states, LOD/LOI, permitted use, responsible roles, and review authority.

requirements.statement: The authoring party shall not serve as sole approver for a MIDP entry.
The Project BIM Manager shall maintain and update the master MIDP across all project milestones.
Information deliverables shall be scheduled with unique deliverable identifiers matching the CDE container naming standard.
Every MIDP line item shall map directly to at least one constituent TIDP task.

runtime_note: The L4 MIDP standard defines governed rules and fields. Runtime MIDP instances in the BEP delivery engine are implementation data, not a replacement for this standard.

provenance.migration_note: Standalone L4 S2 production standard; dynamic BEP/runtime representations are treated as downstream implementations.
